title: Tech-Docs-Refactor Output
description: Refactored professional technical documentation in strict Markdown format.

markdown.description: The refactored output as a Markdown string. Contains no JSON wrapper, no preamble, no meta-commentary. Uses imperative mood for instructions and declarative statements for descriptions. Free of emoji, exclamation marks, and prohibited marketing language.

required_patterns: At least one Markdown heading (## or ###) when input contains descriptive prose
Imperative mood for all instruction steps
Preserved verbatim: commands, file paths, version numbers, code blocks
